title: Candidacy
description: One person standing in one contest, and how they fared. A candidacy rather than a candidate: the same person may stand in several contests, and their party affiliation and result belong to the standing, not to them.

candidate.description: The Person standing. A reference, so a candidate who later takes office is the same entity as the officeholder in the org profile.

party.description: The PoliticalParty they stood for, where they stood for one. schema:PoliticalParty is a real type. Absent means independent.

ballotName.description: The name as printed on the ballot, which is often not the person's full legal name.

incumbent.description: Whether they held the post going into the contest.

identifier.description: Any scheme-qualified identifiers for this candidacy beyond its `@id`.
